source: The first run downloads about 13 MiB of runtime files. Code is limited to 20,000 characters, input to 5,000 characters, output to 24,000 characters and each run to 12 seconds. Browser memory and compatibility still apply.

raw_translation: > Isang-dimensional na klasikong modelo. Positibong at negatibong bilis ipakita ang direksyon. source: One-dimensional classical model. Positive and negative velocities show direction. Collisions are treated as isolated: no external impulse, rotation, deformation detail or relativistic effects are modeled. A value of 1 is ideal elastic; 0 is perfectly inelastic. This is an educational estimate, not an engineering or safety assessment.
translation: > Isang-dimensional na klasikong modelo. Positibong at negatibong bilis ipakita ang direksyon. Collisions ay itinuturing na hiwalay: walang panlabas na impulse, pag-ikot, deformation detalye o relativistic epekto ay modelo. Ang isang halaga ng 1 ay ideal na malagkit; 0 ay ganap na hindi malagkit. Ito ay isang pang-edukasyon na pagtatantya, hindi isang engineering o seguridad pagtatasa.
